options.content: **Costs are partial application observations, NOT your Vercel AI Gateway total.** Compare reported generations with completed calls; failed or missing cost lookups undercount spend. BYOK is inference billed through your own provider keys, not an extra gateway charge. Missing data is not zero. API latency excludes long-lived streams, which have a separate panel. **GEO history is archived below:** selected-range intersection with the frozen 3–10 Oct 2026 snapshot, not current GEO activity. [View the archive range](/d/notra-overview?from=2026-10-03T11:35:08.391Z&to=2026-10-10T11:35:08.391Z&var-environment=${environment}&var-organization=${organization:percentencode}) and expand the GEO archive row.

panels.title: AI generations with reported costs
panels.description: Distinct generation cost IDs with a reported total. Compare with completed calls to detect incomplete cost collection. Reports may include failed charged calls, and lookups may arrive later; this is not an exact coverage percentage.

targets.expr: count(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", costId="costId", organizationId="organizationId", costUsd="costUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap costUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Observed gateway charges · partial
panels.description: Only successfully reported application costs in the selected range. Includes Vercel and OpenRouter; NOT the Vercel dashboard total or invoice cash paid. Missing/failed lookups are excluded and can severely undercount spend.

targets.expr: sum(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", costId="costId", gatewayCostUsd="gatewayCostUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap gatewayCostUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Observed BYOK inference · partial
panels.description: Inference value billed outside the gateway through your own provider keys (BYOK), not necessarily customer-owned keys. Not additional gateway charges or invoice cash paid. Only successful cost reports in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", costId="costId", byokInferenceCostUsd="byokInferenceCostUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap byokInferenceCostUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum(count_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId" | event="ai.call.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Streaming requests · p95 full duration
panels.description: Full request duration for stream routes, not time to first token or ordinary API response latency. Long-lived streams can legitimately take minutes. Windows contain at least five minutes; sparse p95 samples can represent a single request.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,routeId,durationMs | event="api.request.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | routeId=~".*/stream" | unwrap durationMs | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (routeId)

panels.title: Customers · reported AI usage (partial)
panels.description: Only generations with a reported total and customer attribution. Failed lookups and missing totals are excluded: this cannot reliably rank total customer spend until cost collection is complete. Gateway charges plus BYOK inference value, not payments or GEO scan history.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (organizationId) (max by (organizationId,costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", costId="costId", costUsd="costUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | organizationId!="" | costId!="" | unwrap costUsd | __error__="" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Observed gateway charges · rolling 24h
panels.description: Partial reported charges by gateway over trailing 24-hour windows, not calendar-day totals or provider billing totals. A missing generation lookup is excluded, not free usage.

targets.expr: sum by (gateway) (max by (costId,gateway) (max_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", costId="costId", organizationId="organizationId", gateway="gateway", gatewayCostUsd="gatewayCostUsd" | event="ai.cost.reported" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap gatewayCostUsd | __error__="" [1d])))

panels.title: Cost lookup failures · selected range
panels.description: Failed gateway lookups, grouped by gateway. These are attempts, not unique generations or lost dollars. A large count means the observed cost totals are incomplete.

targets.expr: sum by (gateway) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", gateway="gateway" | event=~"ai.call.cost_lookup_failed|ai.router.generation_lookup_failed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | __error__="" [$__range]))

panels.title: API latency · p95 excluding streams
panels.description: Completed non-stream application requests, excluding /ping health checks. Long-lived /stream routes are shown separately. Minimum five-minute windows avoid tiny refresh-dependent buckets; sparse p95 samples may still represent a single request. Missing windows are not zero latency.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,routeId,durationMs | event="api.request.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | routeId!~".*/stream" | routeId!="/ping" | routeId!="" | unwrap durationMs | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (routeId)

panels.title: API errors · 5xx by route
panels.description: Application 5xx response rate, not public uptime probes. Minimum five-minute windows; gaps mean no matching observations, not measured zero errors.

targets.expr: sum by (routeId) (rate({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,routeId,status | event="api.request.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | status >= 500 | __error__="" [$__auto]))

sum by (gateway) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", organizationId="organizationId", gateway="gateway" | event="ai.call.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum by (model,event) (rate({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,model | event=~"ai.call.(completed|failed|aborted|incomplete)" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: AI latency · p95 time to first token

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,model,ai_msToFirstChunk | event="ai.call.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap ai_msToFirstChunk | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (model)

panels.title: GEO traffic · ingested / dropped / rejected
panels.description: Sample-weighted ingest observations per second. Separate from GEO scans and their AI costs; not lifetime traffic totals.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome,reason) (rate({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,outcome,reason,weight | event="geo.ingest" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap weight | __error__="" [$__auto]))

sum by (routeId) (rate({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,routeId | event="api.request.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | __error__="" [$__auto]))

sum by (model) (rate({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | keep event,organizationId,model,ai_totalTokens | event="ai.call.completed" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap ai_totalTokens | __error__="" [$__auto]))
{service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}"

panels.title: Infrastructure health · live probes, not API latency

targets.expr: probe_success{job="http-probes"}

panels.title: Synthetic probe response time · by region

targets.expr: probe_duration_seconds{job="http-probes"}
(probe_ssl_earliest_cert_expiry{job="http-probes"} - time()) / 86400
up{job!~"http-probes|vercel"}

panels.title: Ingest memory
panels.description: Latest service-level RSS and heap samples; independent of the customer filter. Not a replica sum.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", rssBytes="rssBytes" | event="geo.ingest.runtime" | unwrap rssBytes | __error__="" [5m]) by (service_name)

last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", heapUsedBytes="heapUsedBytes" | event="geo.ingest.runtime" | unwrap heapUsedBytes | __error__="" [5m]) by (service_name)

panels.title: Ingest backpressure
panels.description: Latest service-level samples; independent of the customer filter. Not durable counters or replica sums.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", activeRequests="activeRequests" | event="geo.ingest.runtime" | unwrap activeRequests | __error__="" [5m]) by (service_name)

last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", pendingTasks="pendingTasks" | event="geo.ingest.runtime" | unwrap pendingTasks | __error__="" [5m]) by (service_name)

last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", bufferedEvents="bufferedEvents" | event="geo.ingest.runtime" | unwrap bufferedEvents | __error__="" [5m]) by (service_name)

last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", databaseWaitingRequests="databaseWaitingRequests" | event="geo.ingest.runtime" | unwrap databaseWaitingRequests | __error__="" [5m]) by (service_name)

options.content: Frozen snapshot: **3–10 October 2026, ending 11:35 UTC**. These cards count whole daily Axiom buckets, including partial first/last days. They are team-wide and do not honor the customer filter; narrowing the picker does not produce exact sub-day totals. GEO panels above use original scan timestamps and honor the customer filter. Scan totals are not added to checks.

targets.expr: sum(max by (callId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-axiom-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", callId="callId", calls="calls" | event="history.api.day" | unwrap calls | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum(max by (callId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-axiom-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", callId="callId", calls="calls" | event="history.ai.day" | unwrap calls | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum(max by (callId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-axiom-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", callId="callId", totalTokens="totalTokens" | event="history.ai.day" | unwrap totalTokens | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum(max by (callId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-axiom-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", callId="callId", errors="errors" | event="history.api.day" | unwrap errors | __error__="" [$__range])))

sum(max by (callId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-axiom-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", callId="callId", estimatedRequests="estimatedRequests" | event="history.ingest.day" | unwrap estimatedRequests | __error__="" [$__range])))

targets.expr: sum(max by (costId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-database-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", costId="costId", organizationId="organizationId", costUsd="costUsd" | event="history.geo.scan" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | costId!="" | unwrap costUsd | __error__="" [$__range])))

count(max by (callId) (max_over_time({service_name=~"notra-history-database-.+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}", history_snapshot="20261010T113508391Z"} | json event="event", callId="callId", organizationId="organizationId", weight="weight" | event="history.geo.scan" | organizationId=~"${organization:raw}" | unwrap weight | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Workflow and telemetry delivery health · global observations
Sweep errors · latest
panels.description: Latest bounded monitoring sweep in the last 15 minutes. Global operational scope; organization selection does not apply. Missing or invalid counters in the newest sweep stay unknown; older sweeps are not a fallback. Five checked statuses are complete status coverage, not an unbounded job inventory.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", errors="errors" | event="monitoring.sweep.completed" | label_format errors="{{if eq (count \"^[0-9]+$\" .errors) 1}}{{.errors}}{{else}}-1{{end}}" | unwrap errors | __error__="" [15m]) by (service_name) >= 0

panels.title: Statuses checked · latest
panels.description: Latest bounded monitoring sweep in the last 15 minutes. Global operational scope; organization selection does not apply. Missing or invalid counters in the newest sweep stay unknown; older sweeps are not a fallback. Five checked statuses are complete status coverage, not an unbounded job inventory.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", statusesChecked="statusesChecked" | event="monitoring.sweep.completed" | label_format statusesChecked="{{if eq (count \"^[0-9]+$\" .statusesChecked) 1}}{{.statusesChecked}}{{else}}-1{{end}}" | unwrap statusesChecked | __error__="" [15m]) by (service_name) >= 0

panels.title: Pending runs · latest
panels.description: Latest bounded monitoring sweep in the last 15 minutes. Global operational scope; organization selection does not apply. Missing or invalid counters in the newest sweep stay unknown; older sweeps are not a fallback. Five checked statuses are complete status coverage, not an unbounded job inventory.

targets.expr: last_over_time({service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json event="event", pendingRuns="pendingRuns" | event="monitoring.sweep.completed" | label_format pendingRuns="{{if eq (count \"^[0-9]+$\" .pendingRuns) 1}}{{.pendingRuns}}{{else}}-1{{end}}" | unwrap pendingRuns | __error__="" [15m]) by (service_name) >= 0

panels.title: Collector log queue · batches
panels.description: Collector-side delivery signal. Application events lost before collector acceptance are not counted. Global infrastructure scope; customer filters do not apply. Missing data is unknown.

targets.expr: otelcol_exporter_queue_size{job="collector",data_type="logs"}

panels.title: Collector refused logs / second
panels.description: Collector-side delivery signal. Application events lost before collector acceptance are not counted. Global infrastructure scope; customer filters do not apply. Missing data is unknown.

targets.expr: rate(otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records{job="collector"}[5m])

panels.title: Workflow monitoring details
panels.description: Global operational events. Snapshots can repeat across sweeps; do not count them as new jobs. Inspect truncation and budget flags before treating a sweep as complete. Unknown workflow names and free-text errors are excluded by the telemetry projection.

targets.expr: {service_name=~".+", deployment_environment_name="${environment}"} | json | surface="workflow-monitoring" | __error__=""
